name: enron_canary
description:
CanaryBench-Enron
	

Frequency-aware canary injection benchmark for auditing memorization 
in finetuned language models, built on the Enron email corpus.

	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset is part of CanaryBench, a benchmark for evaluating 
memorization in finetuned language models across repetition tiers 
and privacy regimes.

Frequency tiers: 1×, 10×, 50×
Domain: Email (Enron corpus)
Member canaries: 770
Reference canaries: 1000


	
		
		Files… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/anony-mouse123/enron_canary.
rai:dataLimitations: All PII canaries are synthetic. Not suitable for evaluating real personal data leakage. Results may not generalize to other domains or longer sequences.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No real personal information is included. All PII values are fully synthetic and randomly generated.
rai:intendedUse: Privacy auditing and memorization research for finetuned language models across repetition tiers and privacy regimes.
rai:prohibitedUse: Must not be used to attack or extract information from production systems or real individuals.
